categories.main_business_segments: Sinostar Cable Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electric wires, cables, and cable accessories. Its product portfolio includes power cables (low, medium, and high voltage), electrical appliance wires and cables, overhead bare conductors, and cable accessories. The company serves sectors such as smart grids, high-end equipment, and clean energy, with strategic partnerships with major power grid companies and infrastructure projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including gravity feeding, conductor preheating, and dual-rotation traction. It utilizes state-of-the-art equipment from Germany and Finland for production and testing, such as SIKORA online diameter measurement and HIGHVOLT frequency resonance testing systems. Sinostar emphasizes R&D with over 200 patents, including domestic and international invention patents, and operates specialized research centers focused on energy cables and high-end equipment cables. It also integrates intelligent manufacturing with digital factory models and 5G+ industrial visual inspection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as provincial and municipal power companies. The products are widely used in power transmission and distribution networks across all 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in China. End markets span power generation (thermal, hydro, renewable), transportation (railways, urban transit), construction, petrochemical, and industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with a strong presence in the Yangtze River Delta region, including its headquarters in Yixing, Jiangsu Province. It has sales networks covering all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities nationwide. Major production bases and subsidiaries are located in Jiangsu, Shandong, and Jiangxi provinces. The company also engages in export activities, particularly from Guangdong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sinostar Cable operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of electric cables and accessories. It procures raw materials such as copper and aluminum rods and chemical insulation materials from upstream suppliers and sells finished products directly to downstream customers including power grid companies and industrial users. The company also outsources some preliminary processing steps like wire drawing and stranding to specialized contractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in special cables with enhanced safety, environmental, and performance features such as low smoke, halogen-free, flame retardant, and high flexibility cables. R&D efforts focus on developing cables for emerging sectors like renewable energy, robotics, photovoltaic systems, and energy storage. It invests in digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to improve quality and efficiency. Strategic initiatives include expanding high-end product lines, enhancing technical collaboration with research institutes, and increasing patent holdings.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electric cables and cable accessories to power grid companies and industrial customers. The company employs a direct sales model with a nationwide marketing network. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products. Additional income sources include government subsidies, investment income from financial instruments, and occasional service fees related to product warranties and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sinostar Cable is recognized as one of the leading and competitive enterprises in China's cable industry, consistently ranked among the top 100 cable companies nationally. It competes with other major domestic cable manufacturers concentrated in the Yangtze River Delta and other industrial clusters. The company leverages its technological capabilities, quality certifications, and strategic partnerships to maintain a strong market position amid increasing industry consolidation and competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.09 billion, representing a 10.38% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 38.12 million, a decline of 42.55% year-over-year. Total assets reached RMB 4.28 billion, up 8.64%, with shareholders' equity of RMB 1.66 billion. The company has shown steady revenue growth but faces profitability pressure due to market and cost factors. It maintains a robust asset base and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sinostar Cable emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and technologically advanced cable products tailored to meet diverse and stringent customer requirements, including special performance features like fire resistance, environmental safety, and durability under harsh conditions. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, advanced manufacturing processes, and comprehensive quality control systems. Its integrated service model and strategic collaborations with major power grid operators further enhance its competitive advantage.
